BiblicalUsage: Shitrai the Sharonite is over the herds that feed in Sharon in the days of David. He is one of the officers who keeps the king's flocks.
TheologicalSignificance: A man over the herds is a man trusted with the king's wealth, and Shitrai's single verse is enough to say he kept it.
